name: io.github.zxf-work/tgms
description: Bi-temporal graph store with 15 verified temporal operators as typed, deterministic MCP tools.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: tgms[agent] pulls in the fastmcp/litellm extra the serve command needs; the bare tgms wheel does not carry them and `uvx tgms serve` fails with ModuleNotFoundError: fastmcp.

packageArguments.name: --store
packageArguments.description: Path to a TGMS store directory (create one with `tgms ingest` or `tgms synth`)
